summary: Newer Windows versions can be managed over SSH as an alternative to WinRM. It has worked since Ansible 2.8 but has only been officially supported since 2.18.
questions: Is SSH an alternative to WinRM for Windows hosts?
When did Ansible officially support SSH for Windows?

answer_card.title: SSH as an alternative to WinRM
answer_card.answer_md: On newer Windows versions you can connect over SSH instead of WinRM. The SSH connection plugin has worked with Windows since Ansible 2.8, but official support only came in **2.18**.
